text: Every statistic describes marginal posterior one variable computed retained draws chains: mean: average draws, usual point estimate. median: median value draws. differs clearly mean, posterior skewed. mode: probable value. continuous draws, peak kernel density estimate; integer-valued draws, active class count, frequent value. sd: standard deviation draws, posterior uncertainty parameter. q<100 * p>: quantile probability p. probs = c(0.025, 0.975), two columns limits 95% credible interval. mcse_mean, mcse_median, mcse_sd: Monte Carlo standard errors mean, median, standard deviation, sampling error estimates iterations reduce. Good values tenth sd; larger values mean reported digits yet reliable sampler run longer. rhat: rank-normalized, folded split-R-hat Vehtari et al. (2021). compares variance halves chains variance within . single chain, compares two halves chain. Good values 1.01; larger values mean chains mixed sampler run longer, see plot(type = "trace"). ess_bulk: effective sample size center posterior, number independent draws carry information correlated draws. Good values least 100 per chain; smaller values mean sampler run longer. ess_tail: smaller effective sample sizes 5% 95% quantiles. governs precision quantiles, credible intervals, standard deviation. rule applies: least 100 per chain good.

title: RprobitB 2.0.0
text: Replaced former multi-step workflow fit(), accepts empirical data frame simulates data data = NULL. Added correlated uncorrelated normal, positive log-normal, negative log-normal random effects named random_effects specifications. Added latent_class_effects fit(), names effects differ latent classes. Added interpret(), reads estimates compensations effects, willingness pay, average marginal effects marginal effects average covariate values, posterior uncertainty. Added update() method fitted models, refits modified specification. Added decider-level WAIC PSIS-LOO replaced harmonic-mean marginal-likelihood estimator bridge-sampling Bayes factors. Reworked predict() residuals() around posterior uncertainty. Added posterior diagnostics standard bayesplot displays summary() plot(). Improved numerical efficiency Gibbs sampler. Rewrote vignettes: getting started, model variants, preference heterogeneity, posterior prediction, model evaluation.
